summary: Bind tasks to stable repository nodes and select bounded execution context
description: Extend task and worker-context contracts so work references stable repository-map node IDs and receives a fresh, token-bounded subgraph with provenance. Keep tasks declarative and avoid copying generated repository prose into canonical task state.
acceptance: Tasks may declare a strict repository_context contract containing stable node references, bounded discovery queries and a context budget; runtime and published schema validation agree.
Explicit node references resolve against the durable repository map and fail with actionable errors when invalid; legacy tasks without repository_context remain unchanged.

Build, critic and repair execution contexts contain only the selected fresh subgraph, exact source hashes and a clear authority/freshness statement, never the whole repository graph or copied generated summaries.
Context selection is deterministic, follows bounded dependency edges, includes relevant tests and respects the declared budget while retaining directly requested nodes.
Behavioral tests prove task validation, exact resolution, bounded selection, stale/missing cache behavior, legacy compatibility and durable context verification.
